Effective date: July 31, 2026<\/strong><\/p>\n\n\n\n

beesayatv respects the privacy of its visitors. This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected when you visit beesayatv.com<\/strong>, how that information may be used, and the choices available to you.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

Information You Provide<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

beesayatv may receive information that you voluntarily provide when you:<\/p>\n\n\n\n

    \n
  • Send a message through the Contact page<\/a><\/li>\n\n\n\n
  • Communicate with beesayatv by email or through linked social media accounts<\/li>\n\n\n\n
  • Submit other information directly to the website<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n\n\n\n

    This information may include your name, email address, message, and any details you choose to provide.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

    Information submitted through the website is used only to respond to inquiries, manage communications, prevent abuse, and maintain the website.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

    Information Collected Automatically<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

    When you visit beesayatv, certain technical information may be collected automatically by the website, its hosting provider, analytics services, or other service providers.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

    This information may include:<\/p>\n\n\n\n

      \n
    • Internet Protocol address<\/li>\n\n\n\n
    • Browser and device type<\/li>\n\n\n\n
    • Operating system<\/li>\n\n\n\n
    • Referring website or page<\/li>\n\n\n\n
    • Pages visited<\/li>\n\n\n\n
    • Approximate location<\/li>\n\n\n\n
    • Date and time of access<\/li>\n\n\n\n
    • General interaction and usage information<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n\n\n\n

      This information is generally used to understand website traffic, improve site performance, identify technical problems, and protect the website from misuse.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

      Google Analytics<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

      beesayatv uses Google Analytics to understand how visitors find and use the website.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

      Google Analytics may collect information such as pages visited, visit duration, general geographic location, device type, browser type, referral source, and interactions with website features.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

      Google may process this information on behalf of beesayatv. The information is used to evaluate website activity and improve the content, navigation, and performance of the site.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

      You may manage or block cookies through your browser settings. Google also provides tools and account settings that allow users to manage how their information is used.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

      Advertising and Google AdSense<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

      beesayatv may display advertisements provided by Google AdSense and other advertising partners.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

      Third-party vendors, including Google, may use cookies to serve advertisements based on a visitor\u2019s previous visits to beesayatv or other websites.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

      Google\u2019s use of advertising cookies may allow Google and its advertising partners to show advertisements based on visits to beesayatv and other websites on the internet.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

      Advertising providers may:<\/p>\n\n\n\n

        \n
      • Place or read cookies on your browser<\/li>\n\n\n\n
      • Use web beacons or similar technologies<\/li>\n\n\n\n
      • Process your Internet Protocol address<\/li>\n\n\n\n
      • Collect information about visits and interactions<\/li>\n\n\n\n
      • Use information to provide, measure, personalize, or limit advertisements<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n\n\n\n

        Visitors may manage personalized advertising through their Google advertising settings. Browser settings may also be used to block, restrict, or remove cookies.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

        Depending on a visitor\u2019s location and consent choices, beesayatv may show personalized or non-personalized advertisements.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

        Cookies<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

        Cookies are small files stored on a visitor\u2019s device. They may be used to:<\/p>\n\n\n\n

          \n
        • Remember website preferences<\/li>\n\n\n\n
        • Measure website traffic and performance<\/li>\n\n\n\n
        • Maintain security<\/li>\n\n\n\n
        • Understand how visitors use the website<\/li>\n\n\n\n
        • Deliver and measure advertisements<\/li>\n\n\n\n
        • Support embedded services and third-party features<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n\n\n\n

          Some cookies are necessary for the website to operate. Other cookies may be used for analytics, advertising, or personalization.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

          You may configure your browser to refuse cookies, remove existing cookies, or alert you when cookies are being used. Blocking certain cookies may affect how some parts of the website function.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

          Where required, beesayatv may display a consent message allowing visitors to accept, reject, or manage certain uses of cookies and personal information.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

          Embedded Content<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

          Pages on beesayatv may contain embedded or linked content from third-party services, including:<\/p>\n\n\n\n

            \n
          • YouTube<\/li>\n\n\n\n
          • Facebook<\/li>\n\n\n\n
          • Wikiloc<\/li>\n\n\n\n
          • Mapping and weather services<\/li>\n\n\n\n
          • Audio, video, or social media platforms<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n\n\n\n

            Embedded content may behave in the same way as though you visited the third-party website directly. These services may collect information, use cookies, embed additional tracking, and monitor your interaction with their content.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

            The collection and use of information by these services are governed by their own privacy policies.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

            External Links<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

            beesayatv contains links to external websites and services that are not operated or controlled by beesayatv.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

            This Privacy Policy applies only to beesayatv.com. Visitors should review the privacy policies of external websites before providing personal information or using their services.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

            beesayatv is not responsible for the privacy practices, content, availability, or security of third-party websites.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

            Website Hosting and Security<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

            beesayatv may use third-party hosting, content-delivery, security, analytics, and technical service providers to operate and protect the website.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

            These providers may process limited technical information when necessary to:<\/p>\n\n\n\n

              \n
            • Deliver website content<\/li>\n\n\n\n
            • Detect malicious activity<\/li>\n\n\n\n
            • Prevent spam or abuse<\/li>\n\n\n\n
            • Maintain security<\/li>\n\n\n\n
            • Diagnose errors<\/li>\n\n\n\n
            • Improve reliability and performance<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n\n\n\n

              Reasonable measures are used to protect information associated with the website. However, no internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

              Information Retention<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

              Information is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, including responding to inquiries, maintaining records, protecting the website, resolving disputes, and meeting applicable obligations.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

              Technical, analytics, and advertising information may be retained according to the settings and policies of the service providers that process it.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

              Children\u2019s Privacy<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

              beesayatv is intended for a general audience and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

              A parent or guardian who believes that a child has provided personal information through the website may contact beesayatv to request its removal.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

              Your Privacy Choices<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

              Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information you have directly provided to beesayatv.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

              You may also:<\/p>\n\n\n\n

                \n
              • Disable or remove cookies through your browser<\/li>\n\n\n\n
              • Adjust your Google advertising preferences<\/li>\n\n\n\n
              • Decline certain cookies through an available consent message<\/li>\n\n\n\n
              • Avoid submitting personal information through the website<\/li>\n\n\n\n
              • Contact beesayatv regarding a privacy concern or request<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n\n\n\n

                Some information may need to be retained when reasonably necessary for security, recordkeeping, legal compliance, or the resolution of disputes.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

                Changes to This Privacy Policy<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

                This Privacy Policy may be updated when the website, its services, advertising arrangements, analytics tools, or applicable requirements change.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

                The effective date at the top of this page will be revised when significant updates are made. Visitors are encouraged to review this page periodically.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

                Contact<\/h2>\n\n\n\n

                For questions, concerns, or requests relating to this Privacy Policy, please use the Contact<\/strong> page<\/a> on beesayatv.com.<\/p>\n\n\n\n
